source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever a **WORLD EATERS** unit of yours gets out of a **TRANSPORT**, until the turn ends it gets +1 to its **Charge rolls** and its melee weapons have **[[LANCE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lance)**.
